meta.title: Aurea — Coaching for your next chapter
meta.description: Coaching for women who feel disconnected from themselves: discover what you truly want and consciously build your next chapter.

hero.title: Your next chapter *starts* here
hero.subtitle: For women who built the life they were supposed to — and quietly realised it isn't theirs. Reconnect with yourself, discover what you truly want, and find the courage to live it.

about.title: Hello, I'm *Elena*.
about.p1: I grew up in Slovakia and built my career in Vienna. On paper, everything was in place — and yet for years, I didn't feel like myself.
about.p2: Finding my way back changed everything. Today I walk beside women who are ready to stop living a version of life chosen by others — and to consciously build *their own* next chapter.

stats.label: to stop staying where you don't fit

programs.title: Three steps into your *next chapter*
programs.intro: After a breakup, a career change, burnout, loss or a move — or simply with a quiet sense that something isn't right: each program meets you where you are.

items.name: Come Back to Yourself
items.description: A shorter program focused on clarity and reconnection. Understand where you are, what no longer fits, and what you truly want.
points: What I actually want, beyond others' expectations

items.name: Your Next Chapter
items.description: The main coaching program. A guided process to redefine who you are, make important decisions, and begin building a life that feels genuinely yours.

items.name: Become Her
items.description: The deepest journey. Move from knowing what you want to becoming the woman who lives it — every day.
points: Find the courage to leave what doesn't fit

items.quote: I had the job, the flat in Vienna, the 'perfect' life — and felt nothing. With Elena I finally asked myself what I want. Today I'm living it.
items.name: Katarína

items.quote: After my divorce I didn't know who I was anymore. Elena helped me come back to myself — gently and honestly.
items.name: Sophie

items.quote: Clarity first, then courage, then action. I stopped waiting for permission to change my life.
